top_signals.title: Novo Still Has Work to Do to Build Investor Confidence, CEO Says
top_signals.summary: Novo CEO Mike Doustdar discusses investor confidence, drug testing and the potential for expanding the firm's obesity offerings. "We should also have a mindset that we don't have a patent or a monopoly on all the good ideas," Doustdar tells Bloomberg Television. "When there is a gap, strategically or scientifically, we're looking outside to see how we can fill the gaps." (Source: Bloomberg)
